blockers_reviewed.rationale: The A-AA.1 receipt lists the handler 0x44da08, reached from the 0xaa arm 0x42a66e, as an unverified branch. This port is that handler (one word argument, ret 4); direct and Unicorn differential tests cover all of its states. The arm and its gate 0x423f57 are not part of this port and stay with the dispatcher slice.
